title: PR #156: build(deps): bump the crates group across 1 directory with 7 updates
content:
Bumps the crates group with 7 updates in the / directory: | Package | From | To | | --- | --- | --- | | [indexmap](https://github.com/indexmap-rs/indexmap) | `2.14.0` | `2.14.2` | | [sfv](https://github.com/undef1nd/sfv) | `0.15.0` | `0.16.0` | | [serde](https://github.com/serde-rs/serde) | `1.0.228` | `1.0.229` | | [clap](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap) | `4.6.6` | `4.6.7` | | [reqwest](https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest) | `0.13.4` | `0.13.5` | | [worker](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-rs) | `0.8.5` | `0.8.7` | | [worker-macros](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-rs) | `0.8.5` | `0.8.7` | Updates `indexmap` from 2.14.0 to 2.14.2
Changelog

Sourced from indexmap's changelog.

2.14.2 (2026-09-04)

  • Fix item hygiene in map and set macros. Previously, an internal const CAP could shadow the same name in the caller's namespace.
  • Allow const initialization of empty indexmap_with_default! and indexset_with_default!. The hasher may also be omitted if it's inferrable.

2.14.1 (2026-08-28)

  • Simplify comparisons where Equivalent isn't needed (Q = K).
  • Unify index assertions for bounds checks.
  • Fix (or expect) clippy lints.

Updates `reqwest` from 0.13.4 to 0.13.5
Release notes

Sourced from reqwest's releases.

v0.13.5

tl;dr

  • Add Error::is_dns() to identify errors caused by DNS resolution failures.
  • Add ClientBuilder::http1_max_headers(usize) to configure the maximum number of headers accepted in an HTTP/1 response (default 100).
  • Add TLS version to TlsInfo extension.
  • Fix hickory-dns feature to use Ipv6AndIpv4 strategy to prefer IPv6.
  • Fix sending wrong proxy-auth if multiple proxies intercept a given URL.

What's Changed

  • fix(blocking): preserve version and extensions in TryFromhttp::Request by @​wwhsaber in seanmonstar/reqwest#3050
  • Remove unnecessary clones by @​FranciscoTGouveia in seanmonstar/reqwest#3052
  • Add Referrer and Referrer Policy methods to WASM Request API by @​Billy-Sheppard in seanmonstar/reqwest#3049
  • chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @​dependabot[bot] in seanmonstar/reqwest#3058
  • feat: add Error::is_dns() to identify DNS resolution failures by @​JoakoI98 in seanmonstar/reqwest#3057
  • Fix blocking client timeout panic by @​V-Mann-Nick in seanmonstar/reqwest#3060
  • Use LookupIpStrategy::Ipv6AndIpv4 to actually prefer IPv6 when using hickory-dns by @​FalkWoldmann in seanmonstar/reqwest#3063
  • feat: Add ClientBuilder::http1_max_headers by @​smaeda-ks in seanmonstar/reqwest#3065
  • feat: expose the negotiated TLS version via TlsInfo by @​dennisameling in seanmonstar/reqwest#3067
  • fix(error): detect timeouts wrapped in body decode errors by @​raphaelroshan in seanmonstar/reqwest#3064
  • Remove unnecessary clones and a cast by @​FranciscoTGouveia in seanmonstar/reqwest#3071
  • chore(deps): upgrade base64 to 0.23 by @​paolobarbolini in seanmonstar/reqwest#3074
  • perf(body): reuse tokio::time::Sleep timer via reset() in ReadTimeoutBody by @​spellsaif in seanmonstar/reqwest#3085
  • fix(cookie): avoid cloning store and url on Poll::Pending in ResponseFuture::poll by @​spellsaif in seanmonstar/reqwest#3084
  • src/async_impl/request.rs_improved_doc_for_json_fn: by @​Athleteg in seanmonstar/reqwest#3082
